biotools.summary: DySTrack is an open-source Python tool designed for smart microscopy, enabling automated feedback control to track dynamic biological samples, such as migrating cells or developing tissues. It serves as a modular bridge connecting commercial microscope acquisition software to advanced Python image analysis pipelines.
biotools.name: DySTrack (Dynamic Sample Tracking)
